recommendedTextbook.title: Essential Commerce for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Longe
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: The Nigerian Capital Market and the Stock Exchange
subtopics: The Nigerian Exchange Group (NGX): Functions, operations, listing requirements
Primary capital market (initial public offerings - IPOs) vs secondary market (trading existing shares)
Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC): Statutory regulatory oversight and investor protection
objectives: Explain 5 functions of the stock exchange in mobilizing long-term corporate capital
Differentiate equity shares from fixed-interest bonds and debentures
Describe the role of stockbrokers, registrars, and issuing houses during an IPO

subtopics: Forms of business combinations: Horizontal, vertical, conglomerate, and lateral integration
Motivations for mergers: Economies of scale, eliminating competition, expanding market share, diversification
Regulatory approvals under the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act (FCCPA 2018)
objectives: Compare horizontal mergers with vertical backward/forward integrations
Analyze real-world mergers in the Nigerian banking sector (e.g. Access Bank acquisition of Diamond Bank)
Assess anti-monopoly powers of the FCCPC in preventing market cartels

topics.topic: Electronic Commerce, Digital Marketing and FinTech in Nigeria
subtopics: E-commerce models: B2B, B2C, C2C, and B2G frameworks
Electronic payment platforms: NIBSS Instant Payments (NIP), debit cards, QR codes, POS terminals, and e-wallets
Legal frameworks and consumer redress for cyber frauds in electronic banking
objectives: Identify advantages and security vulnerabilities of electronic commercial transactions
Explain the operational role of NIBSS in inter-bank funds transfers in Nigeria
Outline statutory requirements for electronic merchants under the Cybercrime Act 2015

topics.topic: Trade Associations and Chambers of Commerce
subtopics: Chambers of Commerce (e.g. LCCI - Lagos Chamber of Commerce and Industry): Aims and services to businesses
Trade associations (Manufacturers Association of Nigeria - MAN, NACCIMA): Protecting industrial interests
Trade fairs and international trade exhibitions in economic promotion
objectives: State 4 functions of the Lagos Chamber of Commerce and Industry (LCCI)
Explain how the Manufacturers Association of Nigeria (MAN) lobbies government on foreign exchange policy
Evaluate benefits of attending the annual Lagos International Trade Fair
